attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Physical Therapy Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved courses (courses not pre-approved may be submitted only if audited; credit not guaranteed). Live webinars count as contact courses. Max 10 of 30 credits from distance learning and similar categories combined (recorded/Internet/journal/correspondence courses with an exam, hands-on instrumentation demos at 0.5 credit/hour, presenting a Board-approved course 2 credits/hour new, refereed article 3 credits, practice management 1 credit/hour). Post-graduate DPT coursework: 15 credits per course credit. CPR initial or recertification: 2 credits.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of the biennial period (Feb 1 of an even year - Jan 31 of an odd year): at least 15 of the 30 credits, incl. a 2.5-credit ethics course (JAM not repeated if taken for licensure). Licensed in the second year: exempt for that period.
rules.audit_note: Do not send certificates unless audited; random audit with 14 days to submit documents. Keep CE documentation at least 4 years after renewal (N.J.A.C. 13:39A-9.4(a)).

topics.who: Board-approved 1.5-credit Jurisprudence Assessment Module (JAM) from a sponsor listed by the Board; other jurisprudence courses do not satisfy it
Professional ethics course of 2.5 credits or more (live or distance); with the JAM makes the 4-credit jurisprudence and ethics requirement

rules.notes: All PT and PTA licenses expire January 31 of even-numbered years regardless of licensure date; biennial period February 1 (even year) - January 31 (even year). 30 credits include 4 credits of jurisprudence and professional ethics. Live courses earn one credit per hour of attendance (N.J.A.C. 13:39A-9.3 categories).
rules.rule_quote: N.J.A.C. 13:39A-9.2(a) requires that every licensed physical therapist and physical therapist assistant complete 30 credits of continuing education which must include four credits of jurisprudence and professional ethics for each biennial renewal period.
